summary: Cresud Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing the English translation of a payment notice for its Series XLVI Fixed Rate Notes. The notice announced that on July 20, 2026, the company will pay the fourth installment of interest on these notes (USD 28,553,518 outstanding principal, 1.50% annual rate) for the period January 18 to July 18, 2026. The payment of USD 212,391.24 in interest will be made in Argentine pesos at the applicable exchange rate to holders registered as of July 17, 2026. This is a routine debt service obligation, not a special situation.
